description: Change is required in this season #careeradvice #lifebydesign #leadershipdevelopment #fyp
transcript: The life that we've known no longer exists, and within understanding that we have to learn our value, we have to learn how to put our egos aside to maximize our life experience, and maximizing our life experience is understanding that changes here and we cannot fret over what's not working. We have to create systems in order to maximize our life experience. We have to stop and make bold decisions, make bold choices in order to pivot in this next season. We cannot wait for anyone to tell us yes, we have to grasp the things that we want and that we need in order to survive in these seasons, and that really looks like looking at your skills, looking at your value, and maximizing them.
